units.source_text: 所谓“难过”，可能是担心跟旅客的关系陷得更深吧？

en.t: By “hard to bear,” perhaps she meant the fear that her relationship with the traveler was becoming too deeply entangled?

units.source_text: 或是在这种时候她极力控制自己郁郁不乐的心情而说的？

en.t: Or was it something she said at such a time while desperately holding back her own gloomy feelings?

units.source_text: 她对自己的感情竟发展到这个地步了吗？

en.t: Had her feelings for him really grown to such an extent?
Shimamura sank into thought for quite some time.
